bio.text: David Weprin has represented the 24th Assembly District in Queens since he was elected in a special election on February 9, 2010.

He was born in Queens in 1956 and, according to the Assembly biography, has lived in the Hollis-Jamaica area his entire life; he is a graduate of SUNY Albany and holds a law degree from Hofstra University.
Weprin was Deputy Superintendent of Banks for New York State from 1983 to 1987 and served on the New York City Council for the 23rd District in Queens beginning in 2001.
